THE STATE INDUSTRIAL CORPORATION ACT, No. 49 OF 1957
Vesting of State Land with the State Development and Construction Corporation under Section 25

BY virtue of powers vested in me by Section 25 of the State Industrial Corporations Act, No. 49 of 1957, I, SajithPremadasa, Minister of Housing and Construction with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance and Minister of Landdo hereby vest in the State Development and Construction Corporation, the State land described in the schedule hereto.
SAJITH PREMADASA,Minister of Housing and Construction.
Ministry of Housing and Constructions,Sethsiripaya,Battaramulla,06th March 2018.
SCHEDULE
